question: Should the shared Markdown renderer expose link origin through the additive `buildLink` context, or should provenance remain behind a narrower Telegram-owned seam?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but choosing a cross-renderer callback contract is an owner-level compatibility decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve the additive renderer context
options.body: Accept `origin` as renderer-only metadata and merge after exact-head review confirms sibling renderers remain compatible.

options.title: Narrow the seam
options.body: Keep provenance behind a Telegram-specific rendering path if owners do not want the shared Markdown renderer callback to carry this metadata.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive renderer context
